$note: The commit backend CI lays each pinned sibling out at (plan b5820982 §2 P0). scripts/layout/layout.mjs materialize reads this file from the checkout it lays out beside: an explicit --ref wins, then a PR body's pending Depends-On, then this pin, then the sibling's main. A sibling not listed here is read at its main. Shape: relay-app's monorepo.json (repos[].{dir, repo, ref}); `ref` is a full 40-character sha on the sibling's main. To bump a pin, in ONE pull request: set `ref` to the new sha; check ../<dir> out at it; regenerate every mirror of that sibling (node scripts/ci/roll.mjs apply does it; control-plane-api has none: its tests read it at the pin). CI runs the tests that read the sibling when this file changes (scripts/ci-changes.mjs). This file sits at the repo root, outside the merge bot's INFRA_PATHS, so a bump lands without the 2 h hold.
